new_today_news.headline: ACSI Restaurant and Food Delivery Study 2026: QSRs Maintain Satisfaction Levels Despite Industry Challenges
new_today_news.summary: QSR customer satisfaction remains stable at 79/100 for the third consecutive year, though the restaurant industry faced headwinds in 2025 with chain sales growing just 3%, below inflation rates.

recent_news.headline: American Airlines and Google sign record-breaking sustainable aviation fuel agreement
recent_news.summary: American Airlines and Google announced the largest publicly announced SAF certificate agreement between an airline and single corporate customer. The 35 million gallon deal over three years will source physical fuel from waste feedstocks including used cooking oil, with SAF delivered to Chicago O'Hare.

recent_news.headline: Garbage Truck Technology in 2026: Electric, CNG & Hydrogen Options
recent_news.summary: Analysis of alternative-fuel technologies for waste collection vehicles, including electric refuse trucks with regenerative braking, CNG trucks with renewable natural gas options, and hydrogen fuel cells. Reports that over 40% of new garbage truck purchases in 2026 will be zero-emission models driven by CARB mandates and total cost of ownership advantages.
